name: seated single leg tibialis press
description: Press the top of your foot upward against resistance while seated. It strengthens the shin muscle.
instructions: Sit with one foot resting flat and the other leg crossed over it.
Hook the toes of the lower foot under your other foot for light resistance.
Lift the toes and forefoot up toward your shin.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.
